title: Bounded source IDs and defense agreement

prompts.J_A: Start from precise requested relation. Judge all candidate answers, including old R5 and new proposals, symmetrically. Use an actual supporting source ID, not just a sentence with a nearby word. A direct relation can still be a false assertion: keep conflict and semantic fit separate.
prompts.J_B: Act as an independent-prompt defender of each candidate. Search every allowed namesake for positive support before calling a role error. A source explicitly saying a person plays rugby supports that sport. Missing credibility metadata is not wrong_argument. Return direct only for the requested relation; UK Albums Chart does not define the band or song whose debut is mentioned.
prompts.M07: Review every candidate independently against all originals; keep all and only answers that fill the precise requested relation. Retain every valid namesake and complementary answer; no arbitrary answer limit.
prompts.M08: Review every candidate independently against all originals; keep all and only answers that fill the precise requested relation. Retain every valid namesake and complementary answer; no arbitrary answer limit.
prompts.M10: The prior audits may wrongly call a supporting sentence an exclusion. Verify directly against original sources. Keep valid R5 strings and all valid referents; add genuinely missing answers. Do not select only one favorite interpretation, and do not adopt incidental chart/location facts. Give a concise final list and explanation.
